ds_fixture.seam: content_hash canonical serialization (doc 13 §5.1, D120) — Go nftbridge produce-once <-> Rust ds-contracts verify-only
ds_fixture.note: SYNTHETIC. All payloads are hand-composed POL-1/role fragments; all hashes are SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of `payload`, recomputable with: printf '%s' "$payload" | sha256sum. No real credentials, tokens, or key material. The two committed copies (orchestrator/internal/nftbridge/testdata/ and dataplane/crates/ds-contracts/testdata/) MUST stay byte-identical — scripts/check-snapshot-goldens.sh is the gate.

spec: doc 13 §5.1 — SHA-256 (full 32 bytes, no truncation) over a produce-once RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical-JSON payload under the pinned proto->JSON mapping (no map<>, repeated {key,value} in lexicographic key order; absent==default==omitted with explicit presence for meaningful defaults; no floats; int64-as-string; enum-as-integer; bytes-as-base64url).

cases.name: dns_zero_present
cases.desc: dns block with a MEANINGFUL-ZERO negative_ttl present explicitly (uncached, doc 13 §2).

cases.name: dns_zero_reordered
cases.desc: FIELD-ORDER-ONLY diff of dns_zero_present (keys composed in reverse). MUST hash EQUAL.

cases.name: dns_negttl_absent
cases.desc: Same dns block but negative_ttl ABSENT (omitted). MUST hash DIFFERENTLY from dns_zero_present (meaningful-zero vs absent differ).

cases.name: dns_default_omitted
cases.desc: SET-TO-DEFAULT vs ABSENT: a dns block whose negative_ttl carries its NON-meaningful default and is therefore OMITTED by the producer (absent==default==omitted, doc 13 §5.1). MUST hash EQUAL to dns_negttl_absent — the complement of dns_zero_present's meaningful-zero, which must differ.

cases.name: dns_negttl_five
cases.desc: dns block with the DEFAULT negative_ttl=5 present. Distinct from both zero-present and absent.

cases.name: baseline_pack
cases.desc: Keyed collection (families) as a repeated {key,value} list; demonstrates the no-map<> mapping. Array element order is the caller-pinned order (core/vcs/packages/telemetry).

cases.name: guardrail_typed
cases.desc: int64-as-string (token_budget), enum-as-integer (rung), bytes-as-base64url (digest 0xdeadbeef -> 3q2-7w), and a bool. Pins the pinned-mapping type rules.

cases.name: role_document
cases.desc: doc 18 §7 role document on the IDENTICAL canonical path — one canonicalizer, two documents (doc 13 §5.1 'One spec, two documents').

cases.name: escaping
cases.desc: JCS string escaping and non-ASCII raw UTF-8 (café, snake emoji U+1F40D), plus control/quote/backslash two-char escapes; key order a/b/c.

cases.name: host_composite
cases.desc: Composite host document (doc 13 §5, D120 / OQ11): shared block + per-session repeated section. Sections given OUT of session_id order (sess-zzz before sess-aaa) MUST emit ordered by session_id. The host content_hash is SHA-256 over the whole document payload; per-section sub-hashes roll up alongside.

byte_mutated.desc: A byte-mutated transport of dns_zero_present: one digit flipped in the payload. The Rust verify-only path MUST reject it against dns_zero_present's content_hash (NACK host-wide) — never re-canonicalize and never accept.
